title: How far can one Web architect’s vision go?
html:
How far can one Web architect’s vision go?

Hypertext, inference, and hooks: determinism around a model.

One loop, for a person and for an agent Look Think Act

Grounded in
say: The question for the next half hour: if we take one Web architect's 2008 vision at its word, with today's tools, how far does it go? Two halves: running (hypertext lets a model find a path once, then a script replays it), and building (hooks put determinism around the model that wrote the code). Three grounds, each a pill you can click at any time: ZTA, no time to type, and Fielding's rules.
